cues: He said to me, I have finished your work.
I is the speaker, the subject of said, so I becomes he.
Your means the listener, the object, me, so your becomes my.
He told me that he had finished my work.
The rule: first person follows the subject of the reporting verb, second person follows its object, and third person does not change.
